conclusion.established_in_fixture: active action selection exposes a policy-hidden memory defect, reaches the confidence fixed point with fewer samples and lower cost than uniform exploration, and recovers a two-block predictive quotient whose controlled dynamic closure has four states
conclusion.honest_null: the repaired predictor matches rather than beats the correctly specified fixed-order-two action-conditioned baseline
conclusion.negative_findings: passive evidence cannot justify untried actions; a misspecified greedy proposal can waste its budget; necessary intervention cost cannot be optimised away; drift invalidates stationary compilation
conclusion.next_falsifiable_experiment: replace the hand-declared suffix repair family with typed relational constructors and test whether counterexamples can select both a new feature and an intervention without hidden-state labels
conclusion.not_established: general causal discovery, arbitrary hidden-state identification, continuous control, learned action semantics, language, planning, or superiority to reinforcement-learning and active-learning methods
